description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a bald mountain top at night: short trampled grass, bare stony ground, scattered small stones, a faint ring of ash from old fires, muted very dark palette of grey-green, black and cold violet, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
